title: PersEvalBench: Can LLM Evaluators Judge Contextually Appropriate Use of Persona Information?
abstract: arXiv:2610.19314v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) evaluators are increasingly used to assess personalized assistants, yet whether they can reliably judge personalization has rarely been tested. We introduce PersEvalBench, a benchmark testing whether an evaluator can recognize appropriate and inappropriate uses of user history. It contains 403 multi-episode scenarios where user information should persist, transfer, or cease to apply. The benchmark covers nine controlled error subtypes across three families: under-personalization, over-personalization, and misapplied-state errors. Human audits confirm that generated errors match their intended types and that the prescribed uses of user information are reasonable.   Across five LLM evaluators, recognition of controlled personalization errors remains limited even with the full dialogue history. translated_title: PersEvalBench：LLM评估器能否判断角色信息的上下文恰当使用？
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）评估器正被越来越多地用于评估个性化助手，但它们能否可靠地判断个性化程度却很少得到检验。我们提出了PersEvalBench，这是一个用于测试评估器能否识别用户历史信息被恰当或不恰当使用的基准。该基准包含403个多轮对话场景，其中用户信息应当持续适用、迁移适用或停止适用。基准涵盖三大类别共九种受控错误子类型：个性化不足、个性化过度和状态误用错误。人工审核证实生成的错误与预期类型相符，且所规定的用户信息使用方式是合理的。在对五个LLM评估器的测试中，即使提供完整的对话历史，其对受控个性化错误的识别能力仍然有限。在人工评估的子集上，个性化不足错误呈现出最大的差距：人类能识别出94.4%的此类错误，而评估器的识别率则明显更低（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出PersEvalBench基准，通过403个多轮场景和九类受控个性化错误测试LLM评估器能否判断用户历史信息的使用是否恰当，发现即使拥有完整对话历史，LLM评估器识别这些错误的能力仍然有限，其中在个性化不足错误上与人类94.4%的识别率差距最大。
en_tdlr: PersEvalBench, a benchmark of 403 multi-episode scenarios covering nine controlled personalization error subtypes, reveals that LLM evaluators struggle to recognize appropriate versus inappropriate use of user history even with full dialogue context, with the largest gap on under-personalization errors where humans detect 94.4%.
